functions.name: drv_reset
functions.plate:
Reset entry (0x100-0x10C): SVC stack at 0xB000, FIQ masked; body 0x110-0x224 = drv_main in main.c.
Boot: drv_status (0xF8)=0xFF, MVOL=0, aica_silence_all, clear_host_area, init_bank_table, evq_clear, init_midi_ports, clear_voices, dsp_out_clear, fx_prg_clear, seq_init, pcm_init, fx_status_init, MVOL=master_vol=0xF, midi_in_flush, irq_init (Timer A + MIDI-in FIQ), sndram_free_base=0x18000, drv_status='SEGA' (word at 0x38), unmask FIQ.
Main loop: every pass voice_service_x4 (up to 4 ring events). If tick1ms_flag: clear it, voice_monitor_sample+next, restart the loop (4 ms flag not checked on that pass). Else if tick4ms_flag: clear it, voice_monitor_sample, host_cmd_poll (only if host_cmd_pending), pcm_tick, seq_tick, port speed/vol/pan/pitch fades, voice_update_4ms, port_status_export, ticks_since_cmd_inc, pcm speed/pitch fades, pcm_pitch_update, fx_update_ringbuf, fx_ext_flags_update, fx_prg_load_service, voice_monitor_next.

functions.name: exc_ignore
functions.plate:
Shared handler for undefined/SWI/prefetch-abort/data-abort/addr-exception/IRQ: sub lr,#4; save at 0x244; ldmia {pc}^ (return to LR-4, CPSR restored).
IRQ: correct return. Prefetch abort: retries the instruction. Undefined/SWI: LR-4 is the instruction itself -> loops forever. Data abort/address exception (LR=fault+8): resumes after the faulting instruction.
IRQ is never raised by the AICA (only FIQ is wired), so this is a crash trap.

functions.name: fiq_handler
functions.plate:
FIQ handler (the only AICA interrupt line to the ARM). Banked r8-r12; stack via 'adr sp,0x3CC' on every entry (LR-4 at 0x3C8, r0-r7 at 0x3A8 on the MIDI path).
fiq_count++, then dispatches on AICA_INTREQ & 7 (levels assigned in irq_init) through the branch table at 0x284:
  level 2 = Timer A (0x2A8): TIMA=0xD4 (44 samples = 0.998 ms), SCIRE=0x40, tick1ms_flag=0xFF on every interrupt. tick_drift_count counts 441 down; on 0 it is reloaded and the tick is not counted for 4 ms, so 440 counted ticks = 441*44 samples = exactly 0.44 s. Every 4th counted tick: tick4ms_count++, tick4ms_flag=0xFF, tick1ms_flag=0.
  level 5 = MIDI-in (0x328): midi_irq_count++, midi_irq_flag (0xFC) = -1, save r0-r7, midi_in_isr. No SCIRE ack for bit 3.
  other levels: nothing.
Exit (0x34C): INTCLR written four times, ldmia sp!,{pc}^. 'mov r11,#0' at 0x254 is dead.

functions.name: irq_init
functions.plate:
Clears pending FIQ (8 x INTCLR), programs SCILV0=0x18 SCILV1=0x50 SCILV2=0x08 which yields levels:
  bit3 MIDI-in  -> level 5
  bit4 DMA-end  -> level 3 (not enabled)
  bit6 Timer A  -> level 2
Starts Timer A (TACTL=0 i.e. 1 sample/count, TIMA=0xD4) and enables SCIEB = bit3|bit6 (0x48), then acks them in SCIRE.
The SH-4->ARM interrupt (bit5) is never enabled: the SH-4 talks to the driver purely by polled shared memory.

functions.name: clear_host_area
functions.plate: Zeroes sound RAM 0x13000-0x17FFF (host interface/work area, 0x1400 words) and sets fx_prg_cur (0x13474) = 0xFF (no FX program loaded).

functions.name: init_bank_table
functions.plate:
Clears 32 dwords at 0x14000 and 32 dwords at 0x14080 (first 16 {addr,size} entries of the MIDI program-bank table), then installs the built-in banks (sizes read from the builtin_*_size words in the image):
  0x14290 = {0x4124, size, 0x4124, size}  program-bank entries 66/67 = drum kits 0/1 (builtin_smpb1)
  0x14200 = {0x2908, size}  fx_prg_bank = builtin SFPB 'e-reverb'
  0x14280 = {0x4234, size}  fx_out_bank = builtin SFOB

functions.name: evq_clear
functions.plate: Zeroes the 4 KB MIDI event ring at 0xB000-0xBFFF.

functions.name: init_midi_ports
functions.plate:
Zeroes 0xC000-0xE7FF (0xA00 dwords), then:
  PortState x8: vol_target/volume/pan_target/pan = 0x80, pitch_target/pitch/speed_target/speed = 0x8000, direct_lvl = fx_send = 0x80 (all neutral).
  MidiChannel x128 (8 ports x 16): volume 100, level 100, expression 127, isel 0x7F, pan 0xC0 (bit7 = use tone pan), q_ofs 0x40, cutoff 0x40 (byte store), far/fd1r/fd2r/frr/ar/dr/dl/cc90/rr_ofs 0x20, flv_ofs[0..4] = 0x2000 (strb 0x20 to the high bytes +0x29..+0x31), bank = 0x3E48 (builtin_smpb0), prog = bank + prog_ofs[0], velcurve = bank + velcurve_tab.

functions.name: clear_voices
functions.plate: Zeroes 0xE800-0xF7FF (0x400 dwords = 64 x 0x40, although only 48 voices exist).

functions.name: midi_in_flush
functions.plate: Reads the AICA MIDI-in FIFO register four times to drain it.

functions.name: aica_silence_all
functions.plate: MVOL=0, then for all 64 channels: ctl = 0x8000 (KYONEX, KYONB=0, SA_hi/PCMS 0 -> key off) and env_dr = 0x1F (RR=0x1F fastest release, DL/KRS/LPSLNK 0). Each KYONEX write re-executes key on/off for all channels (harmless: all are off).

functions.name: voice_monitor_sample
functions.plate:
Reads AICA_MON_EG (LP15 SGC14:13 EG12:0) of the channel selected by MSLC and stores g_voice[monitor_slot].level:
  SGC != 3 (attack/decay/sustain) -> 0xFF; SGC == 3 (release): EG & 0x1F00 -> 0, else 0xFF - EG.
The EG read belongs to the channel selected by the previous voice_monitor_next (the main loop always calls sample before next). Used to find silent voices to reuse/steal.

functions.name: voice_monitor_next
functions.plate: monitor_slot = (monitor_slot+1 == 48) ? 0 : monitor_slot+1; byte store slot&0x3F to 0x80280D (MSLC bits 13:8; AFSEL bit14 = 0 -> amplitude EG). Only the low 48 AICA channels are driver voices.

functions.name: dsp_out_clear
functions.plate: Zeroes 18 dwords at 0x802000 (DSP output EFSDL/EFPAN for the 16 EFREG + 2 CDDA/EXTS inputs).

functions.name: voice_service_x4
functions.plate: Called on every main-loop pass (not tick driven): 4 x midi_event_dispatch(midi_event_pop()). An empty ring yields event 0 which the dispatcher ignores.

functions.name: midi_in_isr
functions.plate:
Drains the AICA MIDI-in FIFO (AICA_MIDI_IN: bit8 MIEMP empty -> return, bit10 MIOVF overflow, bits7:0 data).
MIOVF sets midi_in_overflow (0x162B); while it is set bytes are dropped until a status byte (bit7), which clears it and midi_in_sysex.
Running-status parser: midi_in_state (0x1624) = address of the code consuming the next data byte (0 = discard): 0x1668 data1, 0x1678 data2 -> push, back to 0x1668; 0x16AC 2-byte data -> push(status, b, 0), stays.
Status 8x/9x/Ax/Bx/Ex -> 3-byte, Cx/Dx -> 2-byte; F0 and F2-F7 reset the state (running status byte kept), F1 and F8-FF ignored (quirk: F1's data byte is parsed as running-status data).
midi_in_sysex (0x1620) is tested but never set nonzero. Complete messages go to midi_event_push_ext (port 7).

functions.name: midi_event_push_ext
functions.signature: void midi_event_push_ext(uint status, uint data1, uint data2)
functions.plate:
Packs an external MIDI message into a 32-bit event and appends it to the event ring at 0xB000 (write offset at 0x13000, masked with 0xFFF).
Event: [31:27]=0x1F flags, [26:24]=(status>>4)&7 message type, [23:16]=0x70|channel (port 7), [15:8]=data1&0xFF, [7:0]=data2&0xFF. Clobbers r3-r6.
NOTE: no ring-full check.

functions.name: midi_event_pop
functions.plate:
Pops one 32-bit event from the ring at 0xB000 (read offset 0x13004, write offset 0x13000; offsets & 0xFFF). Returns it in r1, 0 when empty.
No full detection here (only seq_evq_push checks); a stored 0 event looks like 'empty'.

labels.name: drv_status
labels.comment: 0xFF while initialising, 'SEGA' when ready (polled by SH-4)

labels.name: midi_irq_flag
labels.comment: set to -1 by the FIQ handler on every MIDI-in interrupt; not read by the driver

labels.name: tick4ms_flag
labels.comment: set by FIQ every 4 ms, cleared by main loop

labels.name: tick1ms_flag
labels.comment: set by FIQ every 1 ms, cleared by main loop

labels.name: tick_drift_count
labels.comment: counts down 441..0; on 0 one tick is dropped

labels.name: midi_in_state
labels.comment: continuation address for next data byte (0 = expect status)

labels.name: AICA_MSLC_CH
labels.comment: MSLC (monitor channel select), high byte of 0x80280C

labels.name: sndram_free_base
labels.comment: set to 0x18000 at boot (start of SH-4-managed bank memory); no ARM code reads it (tentative name)

labels.name: fx_prg_cur
labels.comment: loaded FX program, 0xFF = none (set by clear_host_area)

labels.name: AICA_SCIPD
labels.comment: ARM int pending (write bit5 = SH-4 -> ARM doorbell)

labels.name: AICA_MCIPD
labels.comment: SH-4 int pending (write bit5 = ARM -> SH-4 doorbell)

comments.text: drv_status = 0xFF (initialising)
drv_status = 'SEGA' (bytes of the credit string at 0x38)
enable FIQ
reload Timer A
every 441st interrupt is not counted by the 4 ms clock (440 x 4 = 0.44 s exactly); the 1 ms flag was already raised
midi_irq_flag = 0xFFFFFFFF
tick1ms_flag = 0xFF on every Timer A interrupt
4 ms tick supersedes the 1 ms work
INTCLR written 4 times before returning (irq_init uses 8 writes)
after an overflow, discard data bytes until the next status byte
midi_in_sysex is never set nonzero anywhere (vestigial)
'SEGA' = word at 0x38 inside the credit string
1 ms pass: restart without testing tick4ms_flag
dead: r11_fiq is never read
stores the decremented count, or the reload value when it hit 0
return to LR-4, CPSR restored from SPSR_fiq
pc = LR-4, CPSR = SPSR
flv_ofs[i] high bytes: flv_ofs[0..4] = 0x2000
byte store: cutoff = 0x40 (upper bytes zeroed above)
prog = bank + prog_ofs[0]
SGC = (EG reg >> 13) & 3; != 3 (not release) -> 0xFF
EG >= 0x100 -> 0xFF, then ^0xFF -> level 0 (silent)
r0 = 48-(slot+1) = 0 on wrap
resync on a status byte also clears midi_in_sysex
